Its medium-term management strategy, in parallel with continuous development of existing businesses and strengthening of its management structure, promotes strategic measures aimed at forming a balanced corporate structure, and states that it will pursue sustainable group management, expand business areas in the Technical Information Solutions Business and the Digital Solutions Business, and promote sales activities in the FA Robot Solutions Business.
